name: golden-hour-tennis-smile
image_purpose: sporty lookbook and active lifestyle editorial

prompt.project_info: Create a golden-hour tennis lifestyle portrait of one consistent approved adult woman with vibrant red hair and a joyful over-shoulder expression.
prompt.main_subject: Adult woman with long vibrant solid crimson-red wavy hair, sparkling green eyes, luminous natural skin, and a big joyful smile. She wears a pale-yellow collared tennis polo dress with short sleeves, cream-white slouchy leg warmers, and clean white sneakers, holding a classic tennis racket.
composition_elements: Full-body shot from slightly behind and to the side, capturing the look-back gesture.
Subject leaning lightly on a white tennis net while holding the racket.
Lush green grass court with scattered yellow tennis balls, tall hedges, and cypress trees.
Playful athletic posture and natural evening-breeze movement in the hair.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Golden-hour sunset backlight with a warm halo around red hair, soft lens flares, long gentle shadows, and playful sporty-preppy atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: 3:4 photorealistic tennis lifestyle photography, full-body framing, natural proportions, realistic fabric and hair texture, shallow-to-moderate depth of field, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Tennis lifestyle photo of an adult woman with long vibrant solid red wavy hair, giving a big joyful smile while looking over her shoulder at the camera. She wears a pale yellow tennis polo dress with collar and short sleeves, leaning on a white tennis net and holding a racket. Her slender fit athletic frame is complemented by cream-white slouchy leg warmers and white sneakers. The setting is a lush green grass tennis court with yellow tennis balls scattered on the ground and some floating in the air, tall green hedges and cypress trees in the background under golden-hour sunset sunlight with warm lens flares. Playful athletic lifestyle content, sporty preppy aesthetic, 3:4 aspect ratio.
